reason: Replace PVEP candidate-controlled/self-authenticated evidence generation with a base-owned verifier and GitHub Artifact Attestations backed by in-toto/DSSE and Sigstore. This is the minimal OSS-backed bootstrap required to repair PR #100 security review P0/P1 without introducing a second Yance signing or trust-root lifecycle.

upstreamPins.role: GitHub Artifact Attestations using in-toto/DSSE and Sigstore identity/trust infrastructure

requiredSecurityProperties: pull_request_target supplies the workflow definition from trusted base rather than candidate Head
Linux and Windows candidate execution jobs have contents-read only and no OIDC or attestation write permission
trusted runner code and command-set definitions are loaded from exact trusted base commit
candidate Head is used only as untrusted workload
OIDC and attestations write permission exist only in a separate job that never checks out or executes candidate code
final predicate is derived from GitHub job success plus trusted-base command-set digests and binds exact base/head
verification enforces repository, signer workflow, signer digest, source digest, source ref, predicate type and GitHub-hosted runner
